name: [SCOOTERS!] Outwest Chicago 2
desc:
Outwest Chicago 2

PC, Mobile, and Console Supported

🔫 Open Gun Game:
- The Gun Game is free to play for everyone. Players get a new weapon after each kill. The goal is to kill with every weapon in the rotation, and the final kill, which is the 32nd, declares the winner.

🌐 Public Server:
- Servers run by community members. Here you can play a customized version of OutWest Chicago.

-🏡 Apartments
-🚓 Become a police officer
- 🏢 Highly detailed job systems
-🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Fight for territory against rival factions
- 🌆 Custom made chicago map with top tier graphics

🎮 Controls:
Roll - Left Dpad, V
Crouch - Down Dpad, C
Sprint - L3, Shift
Emotes - Up Dpad, K

Officially Released
12/25/25
